title: Resources
text:
My Blogs

Data Digest: Clinical Analysis Newsletter
A LinkedIn newsletter where I cover various topics related to clinical data analysis, statistical methodologies, and best practices in data science. Below are some of the blog posts published so far:


Blog Posts

Apple Watch’s New Features: Revolutionizing Clinical Saving
Drowning in Data: Mastering the Art of Clear & Concise Insights
AI Revolutionizing Healthcare: Rapid Changes Over the Last Decade
Patient-Centric Approaches in Clinical Data Collection
Unlocking Insights: The Importance of ANOVA in Clinical Trials
Ensuring Integrity in Regression Analysis: The Vital Role in Data
Pioneering Clinical Research: A Deep Dive into Sequential Models
Elevating Web Development with R Shiny and Beyond
AI Revolution: Transforming the Landscape of Clinical Data
Navigating the Future: A 2024 Forecast of AI and Open-Source Data

… and many more insightful articles on LinkedIn.

Stay tuned for more blog posts and updates! Be sure to follow my LinkedIn newsletter to receive the latest articles on clinical data analysis and data science.

    Hi, I'm Mahesh!
    
      I'm a Senior Statistical Programmer and Clinical Data Scientist with
      close to a decade of experience in clinical data analysis, CDISC standards
      (SDTM, ADaM), and TLG/TFL generation. I currently work at IQVIA and am
      pursuing my PhD in Statistics at Amity University, Lucknow.
    
    
      My work sits at the intersection of statistics, software engineering, and clinical research.
      I have presented original research at PHUSE US Connect 2023 and
      PHUSE EU Connect 2021 & 2022, authored peer-reviewed conference
      proceedings, and built R packages used in production clinical reporting pipelines.
    
    
      Outside work, I volunteer with the CDISC Open-Source Alliance (COSA) and
      the Kerala Police Cyberdome. I'm a life member of the Indian Society for
      Probability and Statistics (ISPS) and hold an NCC B Certificate.
